review_locator: PMCID:PMC11717358, Exploring neuroglial signaling: diversity of molecules implicated in microglia-to-astrocyte neuroimmune communication
primary_title: Human Astrocytes: Secretome Profiles of Cytokines and Chemokines
decision_basis: The neuroglial-signaling review cites the human astrocyte secretome study reporting newly detected IL-1beta protein after combined IL-1beta and TNF-alpha stimulation.
limitations_preserved: The combined treatment newly detected IL-1beta protein in human astrocyte conditioned medium; preserve the cytokine-combination and human astrocyte context, distinguish released IL-1beta protein from IL1B transcription, and do not infer a defined autocrine receptor mechanism or terminal-TF effect.
